description:
Activate Myr Welder using Empowered Autogenerator's ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on Myr Welder and adding {G/W} for each charge counter on Myr Welder.
Activate Seedcradle Witch by paying {2}{G/W}{G/W}, untapping Myr Welder and giving it +3/+3 until end of turn.
Repeat.
